$schema: Session DevNotes - deviations, discoveries, decisions captured during build

notes.content: Wired EventsSection into LayerForm as part of the LayerForm rewrite (TG3.1.2) rather than as a separate follow-up step (TG3.2.3). Same end state — EventsSection mounted at the bottom of every canonical SceneObject form with onChange committing the full array via 'events' key (deepMerge replaces arrays wholesale).

Toggling Fill ON commits the full transform patch with explicit-mode fields set to undefined ({mode:'fill', x:undefined, y:undefined, width:undefined, height:undefined, anchor:undefined}). deepMerge sets these properties to undefined on the existing transform; JSON.stringify drops them at save time. Toggling Fill OFF restores defaults (x=0, y=0, width='auto', height='auto', anchor='top-left') while preserving the prior rotation/scale.

InspectorPanel dispatch uses data-shape rather than path heuristics: layer.layer → SubLayerForm; (!layer.transform && layer.type==='media') → MediaChildForm; else → LayerForm. This correctly routes canonical SceneObjects with nested children (added by CP2 recursive rendering) to LayerForm, not to the legacy MediaChildForm.
ClipSelect import remained on MediaChildForm (legacy foreign-media child still uses properties.clip until CP5). LayerForm dropped it entirely — canonical Appearance has no clip field.

Reused the same Tailwind classes already used by RangedInput's number input and BlendSelect (bg-[#222], rounded-sm, focus:border-[#4a8fc2]) for the string input and enum select inside ManifestPropertyField, instead of the ad-hoc classes shown in the plan. Keeps the inspector visually consistent.

Manifest narrowing on containerEntry uses `'manifest' in containerEntry` rather than a type guard helper. AssetContainer has no manifest field, so `'manifest' in entry` cleanly narrows to ModuleEntry without an extra import.

Grab-bag fallback in LayerForm renders ONLY when no manifest is attached — when a manifest exists, it is authoritative even if it has zero properties (the section then renders nothing). Per plan: legacy data without manifest still surfaces, but a module with a manifest controls the inspector exactly.
